permits.project_name:
This project is an affordable housing project with 128 affordable apartment units that are for rent. The 128 units are spread across 3 new construction buildings on 87520 SF of previously undeveloped land that is part of the Easton Masterplan. Buildings 1 & 2 are 4 stories, type VA construction with sprinkler systems and elevators. Building 3 is 3 stories, type VB construction with 13R sprinkler system and no elevator. Buildings 1 & 2 each have 52 units, and building 3 has 24 units. Building 3 also has a small amenity space reserved for tenant use (a leasing office, fitness center, and small community room).

This permit is for the Verde Pines Trash Enclosures and Bike Parking Structures.
Building 1 PRNC202504394
Building 2 PRNC202504395
Building 3 PRNC202504397
Misc other structures PRNC202504398
TECH JULIE OConnor
PE: Nick Patten

permits.project_name:
This project involves the construction of a new second-story Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) above an existing single-family residence located at 836 NW 16th Street, Bend, Oregon. The scope includes:
*Adding 689 square feet of new conditioned living space as an upper-level ADU.
*Maintaining the existing 1,285 square feet of conditioned space and the 546 square foot garage.
*Constructing 66 square feet of new unconditioned space and a 125 square foot covered deck.
*Modifications to the existing structure to support the new ADU, including:
*New foundation elements and structural reinforcements (footings, slab work, posts, and hold-downs).
*Framing upgrades with engineered beams, joists, and shear walls per structural plans.
*Installation of HVAC (ductless mini-split and radiant floor heating) and high-efficiency water heating systems.
*Exterior architectural work to match the existing structure while accommodating the second-story addition.
*All work will comply with the 2023 Oregon Residential Specialty Code (ORSC) and applicable structural and energy code standards.
***COB Water*** SN
***No Conditions/No Expired*** SN

The structure is constructed of steel posts and steel roof beams with metal wall panels and roof panels. The trash enclosure it approximately 210 sf single story, "open air" structure.

the structural calculation for these structures should remain in the solar permit 
PREL202500829.  This way they are filed in one location and revisions/modifications 
will only need to be made under one permit.  This permit references the solar permit 
(plans and calculations) as reference only.  Structural inspections should also remain 
under the solar permit.  This permit PRNC202402340  still contains Land Use and 
electrical items.

The project proposes to develop an approximate 6,815 square foot AutoZone store on mostly 
Parcel 4000. Parcel 1800 is encumbered with an existing Swalley District irrigation easement and 
other public easements in almost its entirety. The subject site is currently commercially 
developed land with an existing building and pavement.  A property line adjustment will be 
completed separately by the Owner to support the proposed AutoZone use. In addition to the 
new building, there will be parking, landscaping, lighting, pedestrian access, and circulation, 
stormwater, and utility infrastructure improvements to serve the proposed use in accordance 
with the city of Bend development codes and standards.  Normal hours of operation are typically 
between 8:00am to 9:00pm seven days a week. Delivery hours vary, but typically occur once 
during the midday hours of the middle of the week.
TECH JULIE OConnor

permits.project_name:
Tenant: Public Works- Warm Vehicle Storage- TI
Tech: Darcy // PE: Ethan
The Warm Vehicle Storage (WVS) building is part of a new Public Works Campus for the City of Bend. Per the project's land use submission, this Campus may opt to be developed in several phases with the option to gain occupancy in a phased approach. The permit packages have been broken out according to these phases.  See sheet L001 for definition of the phases and W-G00 for permit packages. WARM VEHICLE STORAGE - FOUNDATIONS, STRUCTURE, & ENVELOPE has already been submitted under permit no. PRNC202303656. This building will house the city's public works vehicles, specialty shops, and warehouse functions for the campus. This permit includes the interior Tenant Improvement (TI) of the parking garage, shops, storage mezzanine, and warehouse. The building will be mixed occupancy with group F-1, S-1, and S-2 occupancies. The construction type is VB with exterior walls constructed with mass plywood panels. The building will be fully-sprinklered as part of the TI package.
**WVS Shell permit 202303656
**Main Bldg 202306031
**Fleet Maintenance 202308090
**SIMP 202303645

permits.project_name:
Tenant: COB Public Works Campus - Fleet Maintenance Building
Tech: Darcy // PE: Ethan

The Fleet Maintenance Building is part of the Public Works Campus for the City of Bend. Per the approved Land Use Application, the campus may be developed over multiple phases with the option to obtain occupancy in a phased approach. The permit packages for the entire Public Works Campus have been divided into multiple permit packages, as outlined on drawing sheet FG03. The Fleet Maintenance Building is Permit Package 5.0 and consists of: Approximately 28,589 SF one story building with a 4,779 SF mechanical and electrical mezzanine, Building is fully sprinklered, building uses include Vehicle Maintenance Shop spaces, Parts Storage, Office, and other support spaces. Building is a non-separated mixed-use occupancy with Group S-1 and Group B occupancies, type VB construction consisting of mass plywood wall panels, metal stud framed walls, and truss-framed roof.
*Headquarters Bldg 202306031
*Warm Vehicle Storage 202303656
*SIMP 202303645
**OPEN DEFERRED: Steel joists, buckling restrained braced frames, steel fabrication - ladders and stairs, exterior cladding supports, aluminum storefront systems, translucent wall panel, suspended gypsum board ceiling, fall protection, shelving/racking design, vibration & seismic controls (plbg & mech), fire alarm.
